subject: general
question: who among the following former Prime minister of foreign countries has been awarded Padma Vibhushan in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shinzo Abe**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The former Prime Minister who was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan in 2021** is **Shinzo Abe** of Japan.
 
• He was recognized for his significant contributions to strengthening India-Japan relations,
 
 
• including promoting cooperation in areas like trade, defence, and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• Under his leadership, India and Japan deepened their strategic partnership,
 
 
• leading to important agreements such as high-speed rail projects and collaborations in various sectors.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anirudh Jagannath**:

 
 
• He was the former Prime Minister and President of Mauritius. While he has received various awards for his service to Mauritius, he was not awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2021.
 
• However, he was earlier honoured with the **Padma Vibhushan** in **2020** for his role in promoting strong relations between India and Mauritius and his significant contributions to the Mauritian economy.
 
 
 
• **Maumoon Abdul Gayoom**:
 
 
• The former President of the Maldives, Gayoom has played a key role in enhancing Maldives-India relations. 
 
 
 
• **Navin Ramgoolam**:
 
 
• The former Prime Minister of Mauritius, Ramgoolam has served multiple terms and played a pivotal role in the politics of Mauritius.
